### Commerce {#type-commerz-testkit-commerce}

`Commerz\Testkit\Commerce`

Swaps every core port for an in-memory fake: `$commerce = Commerce::fake();` then arrange through `$commerce->stock->limit(...)`, `$commerce->sellables->add(...)` and assert on what the fakes recorded. Quote stages and the `Commerz` root see the fakes even when they were resolved before.

```php
final readonly class Commerce {
    public readonly \Commerz\Testkit\Fakes\FakeCustomers $customers;
    public readonly \Commerz\Testkit\Fakes\FakeDelivery $delivery;
    public readonly \Commerz\Testkit\Fakes\FakePrices $prices;
    public readonly \Commerz\Testkit\Fakes\FakePromotionUsage $promotions;
    public readonly \Commerz\Testkit\Fakes\FakeSellables $sellables;
    public readonly \Commerz\Testkit\Fakes\FakeStock $stock;
    __construct(\Commerz\Testkit\Fakes\FakeSellables $sellables, \Commerz\Testkit\Fakes\FakeStock $stock, \Commerz\Testkit\Fakes\FakePrices $prices, \Commerz\Testkit\Fakes\FakePromotionUsage $promotions, \Commerz\Testkit\Fakes\FakeDelivery $delivery, \Commerz\Testkit\Fakes\FakeCustomers $customers);
    static fake(?\Illuminate\Container\Container $container = null): self;
}
```

### Concurrency {#type-commerz-testkit-concurrency}

`Commerz\Testkit\Concurrency`

Runs the same work in N forked processes that start together, each on its own database connection, to prove locking invariants on PostgreSQL. Data must be committed: transactional test isolation (RefreshDatabase, DatabaseTransactions) cannot be used with it, because the parent's connections are closed before forking.

```php
final class Concurrency {
    static run(int $workers, \Closure $work, int $timeoutSeconds = 30): array;
}
```

### PackageTestCase {#type-commerz-testkit-packagetestcase}

`Commerz\Testkit\PackageTestCase`

```php
abstract class PackageTestCase extends \Orchestra\Testbench\TestCase implements \Countable, \Orchestra\Testbench\Contracts\TestCase, \PHPUnit\Framework\Reorderable, \PHPUnit\Framework\SelfDescribing, \PHPUnit\Framework\Test {
    protected abstract commerzProviders(): array;
    protected databaseConnection(): array;
    protected defineEnvironment($app): void;
    protected getPackageProviders($app): array;
    // `RefreshDatabase` migrates once per process, with the schema of the first test it sees. One process that runs suites of several packages needs a fresh migration whenever the provider set (hence the schema) changes.
    protected setUpTraits();
}
```

### PluginContractTests {#type-commerz-testkit-plugincontracttests}

`Commerz\Testkit\PluginContractTests`

Contract tests every Commerz plugin should pass. Use it in a Testbench test case (e.g. `PackageTestCase`):

```php
trait PluginContractTests {
    aPluginThatIsNotRegisteredLeavesNoContributions(): void;
    anUnknownKeyIsUnsupported(): void;
    contributionKeysAreStable(): void;
    // The contribution keys the plugin must provide, by kind; an empty array skips the check. Pin it so a renamed key, which silently orphans stored rules, fails a test.
    protected expectedContributions(): array;
    protected abstract pluginClass(): string;
    protected pluginDependencies(): array;
    registeringThePluginTwiceFails(): void;
}
```

### FakePromotionUsage {#type-commerz-testkit-fakes-fakepromotionusage}

`Commerz\Testkit\Fakes\FakePromotionUsage`

    limit(string $promotionId, int $total): self;
    restore(\Commerz\Ports\Promotions\Data\RestorePromotionUsage $command): void;
    uses(string $promotionId): int;
}
```

### FakeSellableRouter {#type-commerz-testkit-fakes-fakesellablerouter}

`Commerz\Testkit\Fakes\FakeSellableRouter`

    resolveMany(array $refs, \Commerz\Context\CommerceContext $context): array;
}
```

### FakeSellables {#type-commerz-testkit-fakes-fakesellables}

`Commerz\Testkit\Fakes\FakeSellables`

In-memory sellables. As a `SellableProvider` (contribute it from a test plugin) it serves refs of type `$key`; behind `Commerce::fake()` it answers every snapshot it holds, of any type.

```php
final class FakeSellables implements \Commerz\Ports\Sellables\Contracts\SellableProvider {
    __construct(string $key = 'fake');
    add(\Commerz\Ports\Sellables\Data\SellableSnapshot ...$snapshots): self;
    find(\Commerz\Identity\SellableRef $ref): ?\Commerz\Ports\Sellables\Data\SellableSnapshot;
    forget(\Commerz\Identity\SellableRef $ref): self;
    key(): string;
    resolve(array $refs, \Commerz\Context\CommerceContext $context): array;
    // A purchasable snapshot with sensible defaults; `$ref` is `type:id` or a bare id of type `fake`.
    static snapshot(\Commerz\Identity\SellableRef|string $ref, ?\Commerz\Money\Money $basePrice = null, \Commerz\Ports\Sellables\Enums\SellableKind $kind = Commerz\Ports\Sellables\Enums\SellableKind::Physical, ?string $name = null): \Commerz\Ports\Sellables\Data\SellableSnapshot;
}
```

### FakeStock {#type-commerz-testkit-fakes-fakestock}

`Commerz\Testkit\Fakes\FakeStock`

In-memory stock with the port's semantics: refs without a limit are unlimited; reserve is all-or-nothing and idempotent per demand; consume takes held units out of stock; restock puts units back, once per reference. The fake has a single location, `fake`: consuming from any other location finds no reservation. Every command is recorded.

```php
final class FakeStock implements \Commerz\Ports\Stock\Contracts\StockAvailability, \Commerz\Ports\Stock\Contracts\StockReservations, \Commerz\Ports\Stock\Contracts\StockReturns {
    const LOCATION = 'fake';
    public private(set) array $consumed = [];
    public private(set) array $released = [];
    public private(set) array $reserved = [];
    public private(set) array $restocked = [];
    // Units free to reserve; null when unlimited.
    available(\Commerz\Identity\SellableRef $sellable): ?int;
    check(\Commerz\Ports\Stock\Data\CheckAvailability $query): \Commerz\Ports\Stock\Data\AvailabilityAnswer;
    consume(\Commerz\Ports\Stock\Data\ConsumeReservation $command): void;
    held(string $demand): array;
    limit(\Commerz\Identity\SellableRef $sellable, int $onHand): self;
    onHand(\Commerz\Identity\SellableRef $sellable): ?int;
    release(\Commerz\Ports\Stock\Data\ReleaseReservation $command): void;
    reserve(\Commerz\Ports\Stock\Data\ReserveStock $command): \Commerz\Ports\Stock\Data\ReservationResult;
    restock(\Commerz\Ports\Stock\Data\RestockStock $command): void;
}
```
